newsitem.title: GERMANY: Treasuries aid German debt, but worries remain.
newsitem.headline: Treasuries aid German debt, but worries remain.

text.p: German Bunds and futures received a modest lift from stronger U.S. Treasuries near the end of trading on Tuesday, but overall the session was characterised by nervous range-trading, dealers said.
"We are moving a little higher here at the end of the day, but basically there was nothing going on all day with people nervously anticipating new direction in the EMU talks," a dealer said.
By 1515 GMT the September Bund futures contract traded on Frankfurt's DTB was up 12 basis points at 100.88, having spent the session in a narrow range between 100.91 and 100.63.
The 10-year cash bond traded at 101.63, compared with Friday's 101.47 close.

Dealers said the day was largely characterised by nervousness about the future of Europe's planned currency union, with markets keeping a particularly close eye on news about France's plans to renegotiate the stability pact.
"EMU is going to be the defining topic in the markets for some time to come, and the markets will remain volatile," another dealer added.
Such nervousness is reflected as investors shift funds back into the mark, lifting the short end of the German yield curve.
"We have seen quite a few investors shifting out of the France and back into marks," a dealer said.
Dealers and economists alike said they were slightly concerned by European policy makers' insistence that everything was fine concerning the EMU topic.
"The fact that everyone is playing down the EMU troubles is confirmation that there is a problem," Joerg Kraemer, economist at Merrill Lynch in Frankfurt said.
In the meantime the market will remain extra sensitive to all EMU questions and price are not necessarily going to move only higher, dealers cautioned.
"I think the strategy is too used any sort of rally to get rid of some material," said a dealer.
The next support level is seen around 100.65, which held well on Tuesday. Resistance is seen at the psychologically important 101.00 level and after that at 100.27 level.
